summary: parse_nanos rejected timestamps with more than nine fractional-second digits, returning TimestampError::ParseFailure. The fix consumes all fractional digits but truncates the numeric portion to nine digits, preserving nanosecond precision. The fix adds an assertion to datetime::tests::test_parse_timestamp expecting a long fraction to parse with nanos equal to 166666666. Both implementation regions occur exactly once in their respective revisions. No tests were executed.
